instruction: I do not have time to work on this right now. Please place these 12 photos precisely, in order, in the blank areas below the content in the “Core Technologies” PPT, with three photos in each frame. On the first page, arrange one large photo on top and two small photos below; on the second page, arrange two small photos on the left and one large photo on the right. It would be best to also add a light blue border around the title.

dim1: The deliverable is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened, edited, and presented normally.
The PPT remains at 2 pages, with 3 photos placed in each of the four content frames, for a total of 12 photos.
All photos are individual image objects that can be selected, cropped, and moved separately; a full-page screenshot must not be used as an overlay.
Photos do not obscure titles, explanatory text, divider lines, or bottom data, and the pages contain no severe overlaps or cropping.
If the file cannot be opened, the pages as a whole are not editable, many photos are missing, or the layout is severely disorganized, the score for dimension 1 is 0.
dim2: +5: A total of 12 images are placed across the two PPT pages, with six images on each PPT page
